preconditions.description: The number of tasks N must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of dependencies M must be between 0 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(E_i in {0, 1} for E_i in E)
preconditions.description: Each task's execution type E_i must be either 0 (main processor) or 1 (coprocessor).

preconditions.expression: len(set((T_1, T_2) for T_1, T_2 in dependencies)) == M
preconditions.description: All dependency pairs (T_1, T_2) must be distinct.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimal number of coprocessor calls necessary to execute the program.
